<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>MHC Visitor Registration & One-Time Gate Pass</title>
<style>
:root{--navy:#17324d;--blue:#245b82;--light:#f3f6f9;--line:#d7e0e8;--green:#18794e;--red:#b42318}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font:15px Arial,sans-serif;background:#1c854c;color:#17212b}
header{background:var(--navy);color:white;padding:20px 24px}header h1{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:23px}header p{margin:0;color:#dce7f1}
nav{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 20px;background:white;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
button,.tab{border:0;border-radius:7px;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;background:var(--blue);color:white}
.tab{background:#e6edf3;color:var(--navy)}.tab.active{background:var(--navy);color:white}
main{max-width:1200px;margin:20px auto;padding:0 16px}.panel{display:none}.panel.active{display:block}
.card{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:0 2px 7px #152b3b0a}
h2{font-size:19px;margin:0 0 16px;color:var(--green)}h3{margin:16px 0 10px;font-size:15px;color:var(--navy)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px}.grid.two{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px;color:#34495e}input,select,textarea{width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid #bdcbd7;border-radius:6px;background:white;font:inherit}input[type=checkbox]{width:auto}
.field{min-width:0}.wide{grid-column:1/-1}.muted{color:#5c6c79;font-size:13px}.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}.secondary{background:#647789}.danger{background:var(--red)}.success{background:var(--green)}
.notice{padding:12px;border-radius:8px;background:#edf5fb;border:1px solid #c8deef;margin:10px 0}.status{font-weight:700}.pending{color:#9a6700}.verified{color:var(--green)}.expired{color:var(--red)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}th,td{text-align:left;padding:9px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}th{background:#edf2f6;color:var(--navy)}.tablewrap{overflow:auto}
#passCard{max-width:650px;border:2px dashed var(--navy);padding:24px;margin-top:15px;background:white}.passhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--navy);padding-bottom:12px}.passcode{font-size:27px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--navy);margin:16px 0}.small{font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:750px){.grid,.grid.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}header h1{font-size:20px}}
@media print{header,nav,main>.panel:not(#passPanel),.no-print{display:none!important}body{background:white}main{margin:0;padding:0}#passPanel{display:block!important}.card{border:0;box-shadow:none;padding:0}#passCard{display:block!important;margin:0 auto;border:2px dashed #222}}
/* MHC plant logo (added) */
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}.logo-box{width:68px;height:68px;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0003}.logo-box img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}.pass-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.pass-brand img{height:60px;width:auto}
/* Shared folder status bar (added) */
#storageBar{padding:9px 20px;font-size:13px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff4d6;color:#6b4b00}
#storageBar.ok{background:#e7f6ee;color:#0f5c3a}#storageBar.bad{background:#fdecea;color:#8a1c12}
#storageBar button{padding:5px 11px;font-size:12px}#storageBar .grow{flex:1}
@media print{#storageBar{display:none!important}}
footer.muted{color:#e8f5ec}
</style></head>
<body>
<header><div class="brand"><div class="logo-box"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="MHC plant logo"></div><div><h1>May Harvest Corporation</h1><p>Visitor, Supplier & Contractor Monitoring • Offline Registration and One-Time Gate Pass</p></div></div></header>
<nav>
<button class="tab active" data-tab="register">Register Visitor</button>
<button class="tab" data-tab="records">Monitoring Records</button>
<button class="tab" data-tab="verify">ID Verification / Guard</button>
<button class="tab" data-tab="passPanel">Gate Pass</button>
</nav>
<div id="storageBar" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<main>
<section id="register" class="panel active">
<div class="card">
<h2>Visitor Registration</h2>
<div class="notice"><b>Shared offline mode:</b> when the shared folder is connected (see the bar above), records and uploaded ID files are saved in that folder and every connected user sees the same data. If the bar says “this computer only”, they are saved only in this browser. Keep the shared folder restricted to authorized staff and make regular backups. The system cannot automatically determine whether an ID is genuine; an authorized guard must inspect the ID before approving it.</div>
<form id="regForm">
<h3>Visitor Details</h3><div class="grid">
<div class="field"><label>Visitor Type *</label><select id="visitorType" required><option value="">Select type</option><option>Visitor</option><option>Supplier</option><option>Contractor</option><option>Driver / Helper</option><option>Regulatory Authorities</option><option>Outside Contractors</option><option>Tour Groups</option><option>Family and Friends of personnel</option><option>Other</option></select></div>
<div class="field"><label>Full Name (as shown on ID) *</label><input id="fullName" required></div>
<div class="field"><label>Valid ID Type *</label><select id="idType" required><option value="">Select ID type</option><option>Philippine National ID</option><option>Driver's License</option><option>Passport</option><option>UMID</option><option>SSS / GSIS ID</option><option>PRC ID</option><option>Voter's ID</option><option>Company ID with supporting government ID</option><option>Other government-issued ID</option></select></div>
<div class="field"><label>ID Number *</label><input id="idNumber" required autocomplete="off"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Company / Address *</label><input id="company" required></div>
<div class="field"><label>Contact Number</label><input id="contact" type="tel"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Person to Visit *</label><input id="personToVisit" required></div>
<div class="field"><label>Purpose of Visit *</label><input id="purpose" required></div>
<div class="field"><label>Requested Area *</label><select id="area" required><option value="">Select area</option><option>Office / Reception</option><option>Warehouse</option><option>Loading Dock</option><option>Production Area (requires approval and guide)</option><option>Maintenance / Utility</option><option>Other / Specify in notes</option></select></div>
<div class="field"><label>Vehicle Plate No.</label><input id="plate"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Visit Date *</label><input id="visitDate" type="date" required></div>
<div class="field"><label>Expected Time In *</label><input id="expectedTime" type="time" required></div>
<div class="field wide"><label>Notes / Other Items</label><textarea id="notes" rows="2" placeholder="Optional"></textarea></div>
</div>
<h3>Health Declaration (Required)</h3>
<p class="muted">Answer each question truthfully. A “Yes” answer may require evaluation by the company nurse, safety officer, or first aider. Visitors with verified health concerns must not enter production areas unless cleared under company procedure.</p>
<div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Health assessment — now or during the last 2 weeks, as applicable</th><th>Answer *</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>1. Diarrhea, vomiting, food poisoning, or stomach/bowel disorders?</td><td><select id="health1" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>2. Cough, sweating/chills, fever, pneumonia, sore throat, severe cold/flu, or shortness of breath?</td><td><select id="health2" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>3. Headache?</td><td><select id="health3" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>4. Body pain?</td><td><select id="health4" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>5. Hepatitis / jaundice?</td><td><select id="health5" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>6. Typhoid / paratyphoid fever?</td><td><select id="health6" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>7. Discharges from nose, eyes, ears, or gums?</td><td><select id="health7" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>8. Boils, lesions, rash, acne, septic fingers, eczema, or any skin disease?</td><td><select id="health8" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>9. Shortness of breath / difficulty breathing?</td><td><select id="health9" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>10. Recently travelled from abroad where food-borne diseases are prevalent?</td><td><select id="health10" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>11. Worked or stayed in the same close environment as a COVID-19 case?</td><td><select id="health11" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>12. Contact with anyone with fever, cough, colds, or sore throat in the past 2 weeks?</td><td><select id="health12" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>13. Travelled outside the Philippines in the last 14 days?</td><td><select id="health13" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
<tr><td>14. Travelled to any area in NCR or Manila aside from your home?</td><td><select id="health14" required><option value="">Select</option><option>No</option><option>Yes</option></select></td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
<div class="grid two" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="field wide"><label>Health declaration *</label><div><input id="healthConsent" type="checkbox" required> I declare that my answers are truthful and authorize MHC to process this information for visitor health and access control, subject to applicable privacy requirements.</div></div></div>
<h3>Identity Verification Upload (Required)</h3>
<div class="grid two">
<div class="field"><label>Upload clear image or scan of valid ID *</label><input id="idFile" type="file" accept="image/*,.pdf" required></div>
<div class="field"><label>Privacy acknowledgement *</label><div><input id="privacy" type="checkbox" required> I understand my information and ID copy will be used for visitor security and access control.</div></div>
</div><p class="muted">Upload only the ID required for identity checking. Limit access to authorized security personnel and follow your company retention and privacy procedures.</p>
<div class="actions"><button type="submit">Submit Registration</button><button type="reset" class="secondary">Clear Form</button></div>
</form><div id="regMessage" aria-live="polite"></div>
</div></section>

<section id="records" class="panel"><div class="card">
<h2>Visitor Monitoring Records</h2><p class="muted">Search locally saved registrations. Use ID Verification / Guard to approve an ID and record entry/exit.</p>
<div class="grid two"><div><label>Search name, company, pass code, or ID number</label><input id="searchBox" placeholder="Type to search..."></div><div><label>Filter status</label><select id="filterStatus"><option value="">All statuses</option><option>Pending ID Verification</option><option>Approved - Pass Issued</option><option>Entered</option><option>Used / Checked Out</option><option>Rejected</option></select></div></div>
<div class="tablewrap" style="margin-top:14px"><table><thead><tr><th>Registered</th><th>Visitor</th><th>Company / Type</th><th>Purpose / Area</th><th>ID</th><th>Pass Code</th><th>Status</th><th>Entry / Exit</th><th>Action</th></tr></thead><tbody id="recordsBody"></tbody></table></div>
<div class="actions"><button class="secondary" id="exportBtn">Export CSV (no ID files)</button><button class="secondary" id="backupBtn">Backup records + ID files</button><label class="tab" for="restoreFile" style="cursor:pointer">Restore backup</label><input id="restoreFile" type="file" accept=".json,application/json" style="max-width:220px"></div>
<p class="muted">CSV export does not include uploaded ID files. The backup contains sensitive identity documents; store it securely.</p>
</div></section>

<section id="verify" class="panel"><div class="card">
<h2>ID Verification / Security Guard</h2><div class="grid two">
<div><label>Select registration</label><select id="verifySelect"><option value="">Select visitor</option></select></div>
<div><label>Guard / Verifier Name *</label><input id="guardName" placeholder="Enter your name"></div>
</div><div id="verifyDetails" class="notice">Select a registration to review its details and uploaded ID.</div>
<div id="idPreview" style="margin-top:10px"></div>
<div class="actions"><button id="approveBtn" class="success">Approve ID & Issue One-Time Pass</button><button id="rejectBtn" class="danger">Reject ID</button><button id="markInBtn">Record Entry (use pass)</button><button id="markOutBtn" class="secondary">Record Exit</button></div>
<p class="muted">Approve only after visually checking the original valid ID against the uploaded copy and confirming visit authorization. Each pass can be used for entry only once. Exit recording does not reactivate the pass.</p>
<div id="verifyMessage" aria-live="polite"></div>
</div></section>

<section id="passPanel" class="panel"><div class="card">
<h2 class="no-print">Gate Pass</h2><div id="passEmpty" class="notice">No gate pass selected. Open Monitoring Records or ID Verification / Guard and select an issued pass.</div>
<div id="passCard" style="display:none">
<div class="passhead"><div class="pass-brand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="MHC plant logo"><div><b>MAY HARVEST CORPORATION</b><div class="small">VISITOR / SUPPLIER / CONTRACTOR</div></div></div><div style="text-align:right"><b>ONE-TIME GATE PASS</b><div class="small">SECURITY CONTROL</div></div></div>
<div class="passcode" id="pCode"></div>
<div class="grid two">
<div><label>Visitor Name</label><div id="pName"></div></div><div><label>Company</label><div id="pCompany"></div></div>
<div><label>Visit Date</label><div id="pDate"></div></div><div><label>Purpose</label><div id="pPurpose"></div></div>
<div><label>Authorized Area</label><div id="pArea"></div></div><div><label>Person to Visit</label><div id="pPerson"></div></div>
<div><label>Valid ID Checked By</label><div id="pGuard"></div></div><div><label>Status</label><div id="pStatus"></div></div>
</div><hr><p><b>Security instructions:</b> This pass is valid for one entry only on the stated date. Present it to the guard. Follow MHC security, GMP, PPE and visitor rules. Access to restricted/production areas requires separate authorization and an MHC guide.</p><div style="display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #aaa;padding-top:14px"><img alt="QR code for MHC visitor Dos and Donts" src="data:image/png;base64," style="width:150px;height:150px"><div><b>Scan for Visitor Do’s and Don’ts</b><p class="small">Scan this QR code with a phone camera to read MHC visitor rules. Follow all current site instructions.</p></div></div><div class="small">Keep this pass with the visitor record. Do not reuse or transfer it.</div>
</div><div class="actions no-print"><button id="printPassBtn">Print Gate Pass</button></div>
</div></section>
<footer class="muted" style="padding:12px 2px">Offline system • Connect the shared folder so all users see the same records; without it, data stays in this browser only.</footer>
</main>
<script>
const DB_NAME='MHCVisitorOfflineDB', STORE='visitors', LS_KEY='mhc_visitors_v1';
let db=null, records=[], selectedPassId=null;
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
function openDB(){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{if(!('indexedDB' in window)){resolve(null);return}let req=indexedDB.open(DB_NAME,1);req.onupgradeneeded=()=>{if(!req.result.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE))req.result.createObjectStore(STORE,{keyPath:'id'})};req.onsuccess=()=>resolve(req.result);req.onerror=()=>resolve(null)})}
function saveAll(){if(recDir)return;try{localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY,JSON.stringify(records.map(r=>({...r,idFileData:null,idFileName:r.idFileName||''}))));}catch(e){}}
function storeRecord(rec){return new Promise((resolve)=>{if(!db){resolve(false);return}try{let tx=db.transaction(STORE,'readwrite');tx.objectStore(STORE).put(rec);tx.oncomplete=()=>resolve(true);tx.onerror=()=>resolve(false)}catch(e){resolve(false)}})}
function getStored(id,asUrl){if(recDir)return sharedGetStored(id,asUrl);return new Promise(resolve=>{if(!db){resolve(null);return}try{let req=db.transaction(STORE,'readonly').objectStore(STORE).get(id);req.onsuccess=()=>resolve(req.result||null);req.onerror=()=>resolve(null)}catch(e){resolve(null)}})}
function loadRecords(){try{records=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY)||'[]')}catch(e){records=[]}return records}
async function persist(rec){if(recDir){let ok=await writeSharedUpdate(rec);renderAll();return ok}let i=records.findIndex(x=>x.id===rec.id);if(i>=0)records[i]=rec;else records.unshift(rec);saveAll();storeRecord(rec);renderAll();return true}
function makeCode(){return 'MHC-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase()}
function fmt(v){return v?new Date(v).toLocaleString():'—'}
function esc(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function status(r){return r.status||'Pending ID Verification'}
function showTab(id){if(recDir&&!_syncing)syncNow();document.querySelectorAll('.panel').forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('active',p.id===id));document.querySelectorAll('.tab[data-tab]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===id));if(id==='records')renderRecords();if(id==='verify')renderVerifySelect()}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>showTab(b.dataset.tab)));
$('visitDate').value=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
$('regForm').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{
 e.preventDefault();const file=$('idFile').files[0];if(!file){$('regMessage').innerHTML='<p class="expired">Identity verification upload is required.</p>';return}
 if(file.size>8*1024*1024){$('regMessage').innerHTML='<p class="expired">File is too large. Use a file under 8 MB.</p>';return}
 const allowed=file.type.startsWith('image/')||file.type==='application/pdf';if(!allowed){$('regMessage').innerHTML='<p class="expired">Upload an image or PDF of the ID.</p>';return}
 const id='v_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7);
 const rec={id,registeredAt:new Date().toISOString(),visitorType:$('visitorType').value,fullName:$('fullName').value.trim(),idType:$('idType').value,idNumber:$('idNumber').value.trim(),company:$('company').value.trim(),contact:$('contact').value.trim(),personToVisit:$('personToVisit').value.trim(),purpose:$('purpose').value.trim(),area:$('area').value,plate:$('plate').value.trim(),visitDate:$('visitDate').value,expectedTime:$('expectedTime').value,notes:$('notes').value.trim(),healthAnswers:Array.from({length:14},(_,i)=>$('health'+(i+1)).value),healthConsent:$('healthConsent').checked,idFileName:file.name,idFileType:file.type,idFileData:null,status:'Pending ID Verification',passCode:'',verifiedBy:'',verifiedAt:'',timeIn:'',timeOut:'',passUsed:false,privacyAcknowledged:true};
 const reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=async()=>{rec.idFileData=reader.result;records.unshift(rec);let ok=await saveNewRecord(rec);if(recDir&&!ok){records=records.filter(x=>x!==rec);$('regMessage').innerHTML='<p class="expired"><b>Registration NOT saved.</b> The shared folder could not be written. Check the connection bar above, reconnect, then submit again.</p>';return}renderAll();$('regMessage').innerHTML='<div class="notice"><b>Registration saved'+(recDir?' to the shared folder':'')+'.</b><br>Reference: '+esc(id)+'<br>Status: <span class="pending">Pending ID Verification</span>. The uploaded ID must be visually checked by authorized security staff before a one-time gate pass can be issued.'+(ok?'':'<br><b>Warning:</b> ID file storage may not be available in this browser. Do not close this page until you confirm the record is saved.')+'</div>';e.target.reset();$('visitDate').value=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)};reader.onerror=()=>{$('regMessage').textContent='Could not read the uploaded file.'};reader.readAsDataURL(file)
});
function renderRecords(){const q=$('searchBox').value.toLowerCase(),f=$('filterStatus').value;const list=records.filter(r=>(!f||status(r)===f)&&[r.fullName,r.company,r.idNumber,r.passCode,r.id].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q));$('recordsBody').innerHTML=list.map(r=>`<tr><td>${esc(fmt(r.registeredAt))}</td><td><b>${esc(r.fullName)}</b><br>${esc(r.visitorType)}</td><td>${esc(r.company)}</td><td>${esc(r.purpose)}<br>${esc(r.area)}</td><td>${esc(r.idType)}<br>${esc(r.idNumber)}<br><span class="muted">${esc(r.idFileName||'No file')}</span></td><td>${esc(r.passCode||'—')}</td><td><span class="status ${status(r).includes('Approved')||status(r)==='Entered'?'verified':status(r)==='Rejected'?'expired':'pending'}">${esc(status(r))}</span></td><td>In: ${esc(fmt(r.timeIn))}<br>Out: ${esc(fmt(r.timeOut))}</td><td><button onclick="selectVisitor('${r.id}')" class="secondary">Review</button>${r.passCode?` <button onclick="showPass('${r.id}')">View Pass</button>`:''}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="9">No matching registrations.</td></tr>'}
$('searchBox').addEventListener('input',renderRecords);$('filterStatus').addEventListener('change',renderRecords);
function renderVerifySelect(){let old=$('verifySelect').value;$('verifySelect').innerHTML='<option value="">Select visitor</option>'+records.map(r=>`<option value="${esc(r.id)}">${esc(r.fullName)} — ${esc(r.visitDate)} — ${esc(status(r))}</option>`).join('');if(records.some(r=>r.id===old))$('verifySelect').value=old;renderVerifyDetails()}
$('verifySelect').addEventListener('change',renderVerifyDetails);
async function renderVerifyDetails(){let r=records.find(x=>x.id===$('verifySelect').value);if(!r){$('verifyDetails').textContent='Select a registration to review its details and uploaded ID.';$('idPreview').innerHTML='';return}
$('verifyDetails').innerHTML=`<b>${esc(r.fullName)}</b> (${esc(r.visitorType)})<br>Company: ${esc(r.company)}<br>ID: ${esc(r.idType)} — ${esc(r.idNumber)}<br>Purpose: ${esc(r.purpose)}<br>Person to visit: ${esc(r.personToVisit)}<br>Requested area: ${esc(r.area)}<br>Health answers: ${esc((r.healthAnswers||[]).map((v,i)=>(i+1)+': '+v).join('; '))}<br>Visit date: ${esc(r.visitDate)} ${esc(r.expectedTime)}<br>Uploaded file: ${esc(r.idFileName||'No file')}<br>Status: <span class="status">${esc(status(r))}</span><br>Current pass: ${esc(r.passCode||'Not issued')}`;
let stored=await getStored(r.id,true);let data=stored?.idFileData||r.idFileData;
if(data&&r.idFileType?.startsWith('image/'))$('idPreview').innerHTML=`<img src="${data}" alt="Uploaded ID for review" style="max-width:100%;max-height:440px;border:1px solid #ccd;border-radius:8px">`;
else if(data&&r.idFileType==='application/pdf')$('idPreview').innerHTML=`<a href="${data}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open uploaded ID PDF</a>`;
else $('idPreview').innerHTML='<p class="muted">ID preview unavailable. Restore from backup or re-register with the ID file if needed.</p>'}
function selectVisitor(id){$('verifySelect').value=id;renderVerifyDetails();showTab('verify')}
$('approveBtn').addEventListener('click',async()=>{let r=records.find(x=>x.id===$('verifySelect').value);if(!r)return alert('Select a visitor first.');let guard=$('guardName').value.trim();if(!guard)return alert('Enter guard/verifier name.');if(status(r)==='Rejected')return alert('Rejected registration cannot be approved. Register again or follow your company process.');if(!r.passCode)r.passCode=makeCode();r.status=r.timeIn?'Entered':'Approved - Pass Issued';r.verifiedBy=guard;r.verifiedAt=new Date().toISOString();if(!(await persist(r)))return;$('verifyMessage').innerHTML='<div class="notice verified">ID marked as visually verified. One-time pass issued: <b>'+esc(r.passCode)+'</b></div>';showPass(r.id);});
$('rejectBtn').addEventListener('click',async()=>{let r=records.find(x=>x.id===$('verifySelect').value);if(!r)return alert('Select a visitor first.');let guard=$('guardName').value.trim();if(!guard)return alert('Enter guard/verifier name.');if(r.passUsed)return alert('This pass has already been used. Record the issue in notes and follow security procedure.');r.status='Rejected';r.passCode='';r.verifiedBy=guard;r.verifiedAt=new Date().toISOString();if(!(await persist(r)))return;$('verifyMessage').innerHTML='<div class="notice expired">Registration rejected. No gate pass is active.</div>'});
$('markInBtn').addEventListener('click',async()=>{let r=records.find(x=>x.id===$('verifySelect').value);if(!r)return alert('Select a visitor first.');if(!r.passCode||!['Approved - Pass Issued','Entered'].includes(status(r)))return alert('No approved pass. Verify the ID and issue a pass first.');if(r.passUsed||r.timeIn)return alert('This one-time pass has already been used for entry. Do not allow re-entry.');if(r.visitDate!==new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10))return alert('Pass is not valid for today.');r.passUsed=true;r.timeIn=new Date().toISOString();r.status='Entered';r.entryRecordedBy=$('guardName').value.trim();if(!(await persist(r)))return;$('verifyMessage').innerHTML='<div class="notice verified">Entry recorded. This one-time pass is now USED and cannot be used again.</div>'});
$('markOutBtn').addEventListener('click',async()=>{let r=records.find(x=>x.id===$('verifySelect').value);if(!r)return alert('Select a visitor first.');if(!r.timeIn)return alert('No entry recorded for this visitor.');if(r.timeOut)return alert('Exit has already been recorded.');r.timeOut=new Date().toISOString();r.status='Used / Checked Out';r.exitRecordedBy=$('guardName').value.trim();if(!(await persist(r)))return;$('verifyMessage').innerHTML='<div class="notice">Exit recorded.</div>'});
function showPass(id){let r=records.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!r)return;selectedPassId=id;$('passEmpty').style.display='none';$('passCard').style.display='block';$('pCode').textContent=r.passCode||'NOT ISSUED';$('pName').textContent=r.fullName;$('pCompany').textContent=r.company;$('pDate').textContent=r.visitDate+' '+r.expectedTime;$('pPurpose').textContent=r.purpose;$('pArea').textContent=r.area;$('pPerson').textContent=r.personToVisit;$('pGuard').textContent=r.verifiedBy||'—';$('pStatus').textContent=status(r);showTab('passPanel')}
$('printPassBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!selectedPassId)return alert('Select an issued pass first.');window.print()});
$('exportBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{let cols=['id','registeredAt','visitorType','fullName','idType','idNumber','company','contact','personToVisit','purpose','area','plate','visitDate','expectedTime','notes','idFileName','status','passCode','verifiedBy','verifiedAt','timeIn','timeOut','passUsed'];let csv=[cols.join(','),...records.map(r=>cols.map(k=>'"'+String(r[k]??'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(','))].join('\r\n');downloadBlob(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}),'MHC_visitor_records.csv')});
function downloadBlob(blob,name){let a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=name;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000)}
$('backupBtn').addEventListener('click',async()=>{let full=[];for(let r of records){let st=await getStored(r.id);full.push(st||r)}downloadBlob(new Blob([JSON.stringify({format:'MHCVisitorBackupV1',exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),records:full},null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),'MHC_visitor_backup.json')});
$('restoreFile').addEventListener('change',async e=>{let f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;try{let data=JSON.parse(await f.text());if(data.format!=='MHCVisitorBackupV1'||!Array.isArray(data.records))throw Error('Invalid backup');if(!confirm('Restore backup? Existing records with matching IDs will be replaced.'))return;for(let r of data.records){let i=records.findIndex(x=>x.id===r.id);if(i>=0)records[i]=r;else records.unshift(r);await storeAny(r)}saveAll();if(recDir)await syncNow(true);renderAll();alert('Backup restored.')}catch(err){alert('Could not restore backup: '+err.message)}e.target.value=''});
function renderAll(){renderRecords();renderVerifySelect()}

/* ================= SHARED FOLDER STORAGE (added) =================
   Chrome / Edge (desktop) only. Folder layout created inside the folder you choose:
     records/<id>.json   one file per registration (no ID image inside)
     ids/<id>.<ext>      the uploaded ID image / PDF                              */
let recDir=null, idDir=null, pendingHandle=null, fileCache={}, lastSync=null, folderProblem='', _syncing=false, _declinedMigrate=false;
const supportsFS=('showDirectoryPicker' in window);
function hOpen(){return new Promise(res=>{try{let q=indexedDB.open('MHCVisitorHandles',1);q.onupgradeneeded=()=>q.result.createObjectStore('h');q.onsuccess=()=>res(q.result);q.onerror=()=>res(null)}catch(e){res(null)}})}
async function hSave(h){let d=await hOpen();if(!d)return;return new Promise(res=>{try{let tx=d.transaction('h','readwrite');tx.objectStore('h').put(h,'dir');tx.oncomplete=()=>res(true);tx.onerror=()=>res(false)}catch(e){res(false)}})}
async function hLoad(){let d=await hOpen();if(!d)return null;return new Promise(res=>{try{let r=d.transaction('h','readonly').objectStore('h').get('dir');r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result||null);r.onerror=()=>res(null)}catch(e){res(null)}})}

function updateBar(){
 const b=$('storageBar');let h,c='';
 if(!supportsFS){h='⚠ This browser cannot use a shared folder. Open this file in <b>Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge</b> (desktop). Data is saved on <b>this computer only</b>.'}
 else if(recDir&&folderProblem){c='bad';h='✖ Cannot reach the shared folder “'+esc(pendingHandle?.name||'')+'”: '+esc(folderProblem)+'<span class="grow"></span><button onclick="reconnect()">Reconnect</button><button class="secondary" onclick="connectFolder()">Choose another folder</button>'}
 else if(recDir){c='ok';h='● Shared folder connected: <b>'+esc(pendingHandle?.name||'selected folder')+'</b> • '+records.length+' record(s) • updated '+(lastSync?lastSync.toLocaleTimeString():'—')+'<span class="grow"></span><button onclick="syncNow(true)">Refresh now</button><button class="secondary" onclick="connectFolder()">Change folder</button>'}
 else if(pendingHandle){h='⚠ Saving on <b>this computer only</b>. Shared folder “'+esc(pendingHandle.name)+'” needs your permission to open.<span class="grow"></span><button onclick="reconnect()">Reconnect shared folder</button><button class="secondary" onclick="connectFolder()">Choose another folder</button>'}
 else{h='⚠ Saving on <b>this computer only</b>. Connect the shared folder so all users see the same records.<span class="grow"></span><button onclick="connectFolder()">Connect shared folder</button>'}
 b.className=c;b.innerHTML=h}

async function connectFolder(){
 try{let h=await window.showDirectoryPicker({mode:'readwrite',id:'mhcvisitors'});await useDir(h)}
 catch(e){if(e&&e.name!=='AbortError')alert('Could not open that folder: '+(e.message||e)+'\nTip: choose a normal folder (for example a new folder named MHC_Visitor_Data on the shared drive), not a system folder like Documents or Desktop.')}}
async function tryReconnect(){
 if(!supportsFS){updateBar();return}
 let h=await hLoad();if(!h){updateBar();return}
 pendingHandle=h;
 try{if((await h.queryPermission({mode:'readwrite'}))==='granted')await useDir(h);else updateBar()}catch(e){updateBar()}}
async function reconnect(){
 if(!pendingHandle)return connectFolder();
 try{let p=await pendingHandle.requestPermission({mode:'readwrite'});if(p==='granted')await useDir(pendingHandle);else alert('Permission was not granted. Click Reconnect and choose Allow.')}
 catch(e){folderProblem=e.message||String(e);updateBar()}}
async function useDir(h){
 const local=recDir?[]:records.slice();
 try{
  let r=await h.getDirectoryHandle('records',{create:true}),i=await h.getDirectoryHandle('ids',{create:true});
  recDir=r;idDir=i;pendingHandle=h;fileCache={};folderProblem='';await hSave(h);
  if(local.length)await migrateLocal(local);
  await syncNow(true)}
 catch(e){recDir=null;idDir=null;pendingHandle=h;folderProblem='';updateBar();alert('Could not use that folder: '+(e.message||e));return}
 if(!window._poll)window._poll=setInterval(()=>{if(recDir&&!document.hidden&&!_syncing)syncNow()},10000);
 updateBar()}
function folderError(e){folderProblem=(e&&e.message)||String(e);updateBar()}

async function syncNow(force){
 if(!recDir||_syncing)return false;_syncing=true;
 try{
  let seen={},changed=false;
  for await(const [name,h] of recDir.entries()){
   if(h.kind!=='file'||!name.endsWith('.json'))continue;seen[name]=1;
   let f=await h.getFile(),c=fileCache[name];
   if(c&&c.mod===f.lastModified&&c.size===f.size)continue;
   try{let rec=JSON.parse(await f.text());fileCache[name]={mod:f.lastModified,size:f.size,rec};changed=true}catch(e){}
  }
  for(const n in fileCache)if(!seen[n]){delete fileCache[n];changed=true}
  if(changed||force){records=Object.values(fileCache).map(c=>c.rec).sort((a,b)=>String(b.registeredAt||'').localeCompare(String(a.registeredAt||'')));renderAll()}
  lastSync=new Date();folderProblem='';updateBar();return true}
 catch(e){folderError(e);return false}
 finally{_syncing=false}}
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(!document.hidden&&recDir)syncNow()});

function cleanRec(r){let c={...r};delete c.idFileData;return c}
function dataUrlToBlob(u){let p=u.split(','),m=(p[0].match(/:(.*?);/)||[])[1]||'application/octet-stream',bin=atob(p[1]),a=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)a[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);return new Blob([a],{type:m})}
function blobToDataUrl(b){return new Promise(res=>{let f=new FileReader();f.onload=()=>res(f.result);f.onerror=()=>res(null);f.readAsDataURL(b)})}
function idExt(r){let t=(r.idFileType||'').toLowerCase(),m={'image/jpeg':'jpg','image/png':'png','image/gif':'gif','image/webp':'webp','image/bmp':'bmp','application/pdf':'pdf'};if(m[t])return m[t];let e=((r.idFileName||'').split('.').pop()||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');return e||'bin'}
async function writeFileTo(dir,name,data){let fh=await dir.getFileHandle(name,{create:true}),w=await fh.createWritable();await w.write(data);await w.close();return fh}
async function writeJSON(name,obj){let fh=await writeFileTo(recDir,name,JSON.stringify(obj,null,1)),f=await fh.getFile();fileCache[name]={mod:f.lastModified,size:f.size,rec:obj}}
async function writeIdFile(r,dataUrl){let name=r.id+'.'+idExt(r);await writeFileTo(idDir,name,dataUrlToBlob(dataUrl));r.idFilePath=name}

async function saveNewRecord(rec){
 if(!recDir){saveAll();return storeRecord(rec)}
 try{if(rec.idFileData)await writeIdFile(rec,rec.idFileData);rec.rev=1;rec.updatedAt=new Date().toISOString();await writeJSON(rec.id+'.json',cleanRec(rec));rec.idFileData=null;return true}
 catch(e){folderError(e);return false}}
async function writeSharedUpdate(rec){
 const name=rec.id+'.json';
 try{
  let cur=null;try{let fh=await recDir.getFileHandle(name);cur=JSON.parse(await(await fh.getFile()).text())}catch(e){if(e&&e.name!=='NotFoundError')throw e}
  if(cur&&(cur.rev||0)!==(rec.rev||0)){await syncNow(true);alert('This registration was just updated by someone else'+(cur.verifiedBy?' (last verifier: '+cur.verifiedBy+')':'')+'. The latest version has been loaded. Please review it and try again.');return false}
  rec.rev=(rec.rev||0)+1;rec.updatedAt=new Date().toISOString();await writeJSON(name,cleanRec(rec));return true}
 catch(e){folderError(e);await syncNow(true);alert('Could not save to the shared folder: '+(e.message||e)+'\nYour change was NOT saved.');return false}}
async function storeAny(r){
 if(!recDir)return storeRecord(r);
 try{
  if(r.idFileData)await writeIdFile(r,r.idFileData);
  let cur=null;try{let fh=await recDir.getFileHandle(r.id+'.json');cur=JSON.parse(await(await fh.getFile()).text())}catch(e){}
  r.rev=((cur&&cur.rev)||r.rev||0)+1;await writeJSON(r.id+'.json',cleanRec(r));return true}
 catch(e){folderError(e);return false}}
async function sharedGetStored(id,asUrl){
 let r=records.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!r||!r.idFilePath)return null;
 try{let fh=await idDir.getFileHandle(r.idFilePath),f=await fh.getFile();
  if(asUrl)return {...r,idFileData:URL.createObjectURL(f)};
  return {...r,idFileData:await blobToDataUrl(f)}}
 catch(e){return null}}

/* Move registrations that were saved only on this computer into the shared folder (asks first) */
async function migrateLocal(local){
 let missing=[];
 for(const r of local){try{await recDir.getFileHandle(r.id+'.json')}catch(e){if(e&&e.name==='NotFoundError')missing.push(r)}}
 if(!missing.length||_declinedMigrate)return;
 if(!confirm(missing.length+' registration(s) were saved only on THIS computer and are not in the shared folder yet.\n\nCopy them to the shared folder now so everyone can see them?')){_declinedMigrate=true;return}
 let moved=[];
 for(const m of missing){
  let full=await getLocalFull(m.id)||m;
  try{if(full.idFileData)await writeIdFile(full,full.idFileData);full.rev=1;await writeJSON(full.id+'.json',cleanRec(full));moved.push(full.id)}catch(e){folderError(e)}}
 let keep=local.filter(r=>!moved.includes(r.id)&&missing.some(x=>x.id===r.id));
 try{localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY,JSON.stringify(keep.map(r=>({...r,idFileData:null}))))}catch(e){}
 if(db)for(const id of moved){try{db.transaction(STORE,'readwrite').objectStore(STORE).delete(id)}catch(e){}}
 alert(moved.length+' registration(s) copied to the shared folder.')}
function getLocalFull(id){return new Promise(resolve=>{if(!db){resolve(null);return}try{let req=db.transaction(STORE,'readonly').objectStore(STORE).get(id);req.onsuccess=()=>resolve(req.result||null);req.onerror=()=>resolve(null)}catch(e){resolve(null)}})}

(async()=>{db=await openDB();loadRecords();if(db){try{let req=db.transaction(STORE,'readonly').objectStore(STORE).getAll();req.onsuccess=()=>{let saved=req.result||[];for(let r of saved){if(!records.some(x=>x.id===r.id))records.push(r)}saveAll();renderAll()}}catch(e){}}renderAll();await tryReconnect()})();
</script></body></html>
